title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA-1998 9.7.2 A look into the prosecutions, that were launched into the Tax evasion, reveals that conviction awarded was low for such prosecutions. During the financial year (1998-99), of the 120 cases which were prosecuted under Direct Taxes enactments, 41 cases were compounded, 67 cases were acquitted and only 12 cases resulted in convictions (See Annexure-III, Statement-III).
